title: Goat OS stg — SLO / burn rate
description: Availability + latency SLOs with multi-window burn-rate framing per OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 7. Every threshold below is read directly from infra/envs/stg/variables.tf so this dashboard cannot drift from the alert policies in infra/envs/stg/monitoring.tf: api_availability_slo=99.5%, api_error_rate_alert_threshold_ratio=1%, api_latency_p99_read_slo_seconds=0.8s, api_latency_p99_write_slo_seconds=1.5s, consumer_lag_slo_seconds=60s, notification_success_slo_ratio=99% (failure alert threshold 1%). Queried through the 'Google Cloud Monitoring' (stackdriver) datasource — this environment has no Prometheus datasource; ratio panels use Cloud Monitoring's native MQL join (verified live) instead of PromQL.

panels.title: API availability — 7d (SLO 99.5%)
panels.description: 100 * (1 - 5xx/total) over the dashboard's selected window (default 7d; widen to 30d via the time picker for the official monthly figure). SLO 99.5% = api_availability_slo.

timeSeriesQuery.query: { err: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | filter metric.status_class == '5xx' | align rate(1h) | every 1h | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] ; total: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | align rate(1h) | every 1h | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] } | join | value 100 * (1 - val(0) / val(1))

panels.title: Error budget remaining (this window)
panels.description: 100 - (100 * observed error rate / (1 - SLO)) as a percent-of-budget-remaining gauge. 0% means the entire 30-day error budget for 99.5% availability is exhausted at the current burn rate; negative means already over budget.

timeSeriesQuery.query: { err: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | filter metric.status_class == '5xx' | align rate(1h) | every 1h | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] ; total: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | align rate(1h) | every 1h | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] } | join | value 100 * (1 - (val(0) / val(1)) / 0.005)

panels.title: Error budget burn rate (1h / 6h windows)
panels.description: Burn rate = observed error rate / (1 - SLO). A burn rate of 1.0 exhausts the full 30d error budget in exactly 30d. Threshold lines at 14.4x (fast/1h page, matches Google SRE multi-window guidance) and 6x (slow/6h page) — infra/envs/stg/monitoring.tf's api_error_rate_slo_burn policy currently pages on the simpler 'error rate over 5m exceeds 1%' condition rather than these exact multipliers; the lines below show where a genuine multi-window burn-rate alert would sit if adopted.

timeSeriesQuery.query: { err: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | filter metric.status_class == '5xx' | align rate(1h) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] ; total: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | align rate(1h) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] } | join | value (val(0) / val(1)) / 0.005

{ err: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | filter metric.status_class == '5xx' | align rate(6h) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] ; total: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_requests_total/counter' | align rate(6h) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] } | join | value (val(0) / val(1)) / 0.005

panels.title: Read-path p99 latency (SLO < 800ms)
panels.description: prometheus.googleapis.com/http_server_request_duration_seconds/histogram, filtered to GET/HEAD, p99. Matches api_latency_p99_burn's read-path condition in monitoring.tf.

panels.title: Write-path p99 latency (SLO < 1500ms)
panels.description: Same histogram filtered to POST — matches api_latency_p99_write_burn's write-path condition (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE in monitoring.tf; Cloud Monitoring's classic filter DSL supports one_of(...) for the full method set, shown for POST here to keep the query single-metric and side-step the 'matches more than one metric' ambiguity seen with multi-value equality filters in testing).

panels.title: Outbox publish lag p99 + consumer lag (SLO consumer lag < 60s)
panels.description: kernel.outbox.publish.duration p99 alongside kernel.consumer.lag. consumer_lag_slo_seconds = 60s (kernel_consumer_lag alert policy).

panels.title: Notification dispatch success rate (SLO > 99%)
panels.description: 100 * (1 - rate(kernel.notify.failures) / rate(kernel.notify.send.duration count)). notification_success_slo_ratio = 99%; failure alert threshold 1%.

timeSeriesQuery.query: { fail: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/kernel_notify_failures_total/counter' | align rate(15m) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] ; sent: fetch generic_task :: 'prometheus.googleapis.com/kernel_notify_send_duration_seconds/histogram' | align rate(15m) | every 5m | group_by [], [value: sum(val())] } | join | value 100 * (1 - val(0) / val(1))

options.content:
| Policy | Condition | Threshold |
|---|---|---|
| `cloud_run_errors` | Cloud Run service/job emits an ERROR-severity log | any |
| `outbox_relay_dead_letter` | outbox relay job logs `dead_letter > 0` | any |
| `pubsub_dlq_backlog` | `num_undelivered_messages` on `goatos-stg-outbox-events-dlq-inspect` | > 0 for 5m |
| `cloud_sql_cpu` | Cloud SQL CPU utilization | > 80% for 5m |
| `api_error_rate_slo_burn` | 5xx rate / total rate | > 1% for 5m (SLO 99.5%) |
| `api_latency_p99_burn` | read-path p99 | > 800ms for 5m |
| `api_latency_p99_write_burn` | write-path p99 (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) | > 1500ms for 5m |
| `kernel_consumer_lag` | `kernel.consumer.lag` | > 60s for 5m |
| `kernel_notification_failure_rate` | notify failure rate | > 1% for 5m (SLO success > 99%) |

This table is a read-only mirror for context — the alert policies themselves are Terraform-managed in `infra/envs/stg/monitoring.tf` / `infra/envs/stg/variables.tf`, not edited from Grafana.
